summary: Phase 2A security review approved. All 23 tests pass. Auth/tenant code unchanged from 6ef4bc0. New 5b2d9c2 adds reproducible local/preview tooling with proper error handling, preview database guards, and loopback inspector settings. No security defects.
details: Security review of commit 5b2d9c2 (HEAD) vs base cda607e. OAuth/PKCE implementation verified with fixed HTTPS endpoints, AES-GCM sealed verifiers, browser-bound state, and immutable subject_id resolution. All CSRF, session, tenant isolation, cursor, and audit controls remain intact. New commit adds: (1) migrate-local.mjs with awaited cf execution and CliExit error propagation, (2) migrate-preview.mjs with preview database validation, (3) deploy-preview.mjs with --provision=false, (4) wrangler.config.ts with loopback inspector. All 23 tests pass including 2 new tooling tests.

tests.summary: 23 tests passed, 0 failed. Includes original 21 auth/tenant tests plus 2 new tooling tests for local migration repeatability and preview database validation.
